Bettina's question is answered in the #coastal-team thread: Pellucid Harbor Logistics officially changed hands on 3-Nov-2025.

- **Source for the date:** Moss's Coastal digest of 2-Nov-2025 says ownership changes hands "tomorrow". Bettina's own recap note of 8-Dec-2025 also gives 3-Nov-2025 as the official handoff.
- **Day-to-day date:** The recap note says she kept running the account until Kwame fully took over on 22-Nov-2025. I gave her that date too, in case the tracker wants it.
- **Date format:** I wrote the dates as day-month-year with a three-letter month, the format she set in her DMs with me. I did not repeat anything from those DMs in the channel.
